# Flossie Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)</sub>

## Appearance

Flossie is too heavy to play a fairy queen, possessing a weight that renders such a role absurd. As she reaches adulthood, she is noted to resemble her mother's cousin, Aunt Drusilla.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v3 c11 P41](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0041)_

## Personality

Flossie is dishonest, spiteful, and possesses a caustic tongue. Lacking imagination and creativity, she is adversarial, jealous of others' achievements, and rarely hesitant to express blunt disbelief or ask forward questions. Despite her general unpleasantness, she is capable of acting extraordinarily friendly or polite when occasion requires.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P9](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0009), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c25 P47](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0047), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v3 c2 P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 c16 P2](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0002)_

- gain an education at college without needing to earn a living  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

While attending school under Mr. Pidgeon, Flossie was caught cheating during a spelling test by Nell Harcourt. Later, during a gathering of young girls, she successfully walked the Pembroke garden fence on a dare and subsequently challenged Nell to walk the kitchen roof ridgepole, resulting in Nell falling and injuring her ankle. When a school concert was organized, Flossie became moody after being denied the role of fairy queen due to her heavy build, though she later attended the successful event. She earned top prize for knitted lace at a local exhibition. Upon entering the Regent's class, she prepared for the Entrance exams, barely passing with a three-point margin. She went on to attend the Academy at Regent's, lodging in the same house as Frank Stockley. After passing her courses, she chose to return to Regent's for a second year rather than teach. She helped host a send-off party for Nell and Hugh Carrow, showing unusual friendliness toward Nell. Later, she spread malicious gossip claiming Nell had stolen her prize-winning story.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P18](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0018), [v1 c23 P37](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0037), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c25 P47](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0047), [v1 c29 P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034), [v3 c2 P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 c16 P2](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0002)_
